home.lede: He kēmu whakaahua māmā, he whakaahua matawhānui, me ētahi mahi hei ngahau tahi—i runga i tō kōrua ake tere.

steps.title: Kōwhiria he kaupapa e mōhiotia ana
steps.text: He whakaahua o ngā kapu tī, ngā kāriki, ngā mōkai me ngā kaipuke rā. Kāore he tuhinga, he ture rānei hei ako i te tuatahi.

steps.title: E noho taha ki te taha
steps.text: Tukua mā te tangata e pā atu. Kōrerohia ngā whakaahua. Ki te kore e ōrite, he tatari noa iho mō te pānga mai e whai ake nei.

steps.title: Whakamutua i te wā e pai tonu ana te noho
steps.text: He mahi oti pai tonu te kēmu kotahi. Kei te mata tonu te kōwhiringa “Kua mutu mō tēnei wā”.

home.stageEyebrow: I tua atu i te mata rorohiko
home.stageTitle: He whakaaro mahi mō ia wāhanga o te oranga
home.stageLede: He waiata, he mahi o ia rā, he maumahara ngātahi me ngā wā marie ā-rongo, he mea whakarite kia hāngai ki te āhua e pai ana ināianei.

stages.title: Wāhanga moata
stages.text: Haere tonu ngā mahi e pai ana ki a rātou, me ētahi whakarerekētanga iti: ngā runaruna, ngā haerenga poto, ngā kēmu kupu me te whakamahere tahi.
stages.label: He whakaaro mō te wāhanga moata

stages.title: Wāhanga waenga
stages.text: He mahi māmā, he mea mōhio kua wehea kia whai wāhanga iti: te kopa kākahu, te whakariterite taonga, te waiata, ngā kēmu whakaahua me ngā hīkoi poto.
stages.label: He whakaaro mō te wāhanga waenga

stages.title: Wāhanga whakamutunga
stages.text: He whakamarie me te hononga mā te pā o te ringa, te reo me te titiro: te panipani ringa, ngā waiata tino pai, ngā whakaahua tawhito me te noho tahi noa.
stages.label: He whakaaro mō te wāhanga whakamutunga

home.specificHtml: E rapu ana i tētahi mea motuhake? Whakamātauria ngā mahi me ngā kēmu mō te mate Alzheimer, ngā kēmu mahara mārie, ngā pātai ngāwari me ngā panga.
home.approachTitle: He mahi tahi, ehara i te whakamātautau mahara
home.approachLede: He maha ngā “kēmu roro” he mea hanga huri noa i te tere, te tapeke māka me ngā pae whakatutukitanga. Ki te tangata e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware, ka rite pea tēnā ki tētahi whakamātautau kura. Ko tā mātou kē, he hanga i te mea rerekē katoa.
home.approachLink: He aha i pēnei ai tā mātou hoahoa

principles.title: Kāore he mea e hinga ai
principles.text: Kāore he karaka, he māka, he whakahaere oranga, he tūnga whakamutunga rānei. Ko te whakaahua rerekē he okiokinga noa, ehara i te hapa.

principles.title: Ka noho tuwhera tonu ngā whakaahua
principles.text: He mōhio ki te whakaahua, kaua ko te pīkau mahara. Ka tīmata te whakatōpū whakaahua e anga whakarunga ana, nō reira kāore he mea hei maumahara ake.

principles.title: Hāngai ana ki te hunga pakeke, he whakaute
principles.text: He reo mahana, he māmā, me ngā whakaahua tūturu o te ao. Kāore rawa he pikitia tamariki, he kōrero kōhungahunga rānei.

principles.title: He tūmataiti mai i te orokohanganga
principles.text: Kāore he pūkete, he pānui hokohoko rānei. E kore rawa ō whakaahua e wehe atu i tō pūrere.

home.guidesTitle: He ārahi whaihua mō te tiaki i ia rā

guides.title: Pēhea te tākaro kēmu ngātahi
guides.text: Te whakarite wāhi, te tere o te mahi, me ngā mahi ina mutu te ngahau o te kēmu.

guides.title: Ina kī mai te tangata kāore ia e hiahia ki tētahi mahi
guides.text: Ngā take noa mō te whakakāhore, me ngā huarahi mārie hei whakamātau anō ā tōna wā.

guides.title: Te whakarite i tētahi papa rorohiko
guides.text: He kupu nui ake, he iti ake ngā whakararuraru, me te mata kāinga māmā kotahi noa.

guides.title: He mahi koreutu hei tā
guides.text: He kimi kupu me ngā kupu rahi, he whārangi whakakao tae, he pingo me ngā kāri kōrerorero.

home.researchTitle: Te hauora roro: ngā kōrero tūturu mai i te rangahau
home.researchText: Ka taea rānei te ārai i te mate wareware? He āwhina rānei tā ngā kēmu roro? Pēhea te nohopuku, te kai, te moe me te rongo tangi? He whakautu māmā me ōna putake kōrero, tae atu ki ngā wāhi e ngoikore tonu ana ngā taunakitanga.
home.appTitle: Golden Moments i runga i te iPhone, iPad me te Android
home.appText: Ka mahi noa te taupānga koreutu ahakoa kāore he hononga ipurangi, ā, ka taea te whakamahi i ngā whakaahua whānau e kōwhiria ana e koe, e pupuritia ana hei tārua ki tō pūrere anake. He hoahoa mārie anō hoki: e whā ngā tāpa nunui, kāore he taima, kāore he māka.

faq.q: He aha ētahi kēmu pai mō te hunga whai mate wareware?
faq.a: He māmā noa iho ngā kēmu pai, he matawhānui, ā, kāore he pēhanga: he whakaahua nui hei whakataurite, he kōmaka haere, he panga ngāwari, he whakaoti whakataukī rongonui, he whakakikī tae, he pīngo whakaahua me ngā kāri kōrerorero. Ko te kōwhiringa tino pai rawa atu ko tērā e pārekareka ana ki te tangata i tēnei rā. Kaua e whakamahi i ngā matawā, ngā māka, i ngā mea rānei e rite ana ki te whakamātautau.

faq.q: He kore utu ēnei kēmu mate wareware?
faq.a: Āe. He kore utu ngā kēmu me ngā rauemi tā katoa i runga i a Golden Moments, kāore he pūkete hei hanga, he whakauru ingoa, he tikiake rānei. Ka rere tonu ngā kēmu i roto i te pūtirotiro paetukutuku i runga waea, papa rorohiko, rorohiko rānei.

faq.q: Ka ārai rānei ngā kēmu roro i te mate wareware?
faq.a: Kāore anō tētahi kēmu kia whakaaturia hei ārai i te mate wareware, ā, kāore a Golden Moments e kī ana ka rongoā, ka ārai rānei i tētahi mea. He mea whakangahau ā mātou kēmu, kia noho tahi ai te tangata. Kei tā mātou wāhanga hauora roro e whakamārama ana i ngā mea e whakaaturia ana, e kore hoki e whakaaturia ana e ngā rangahau.

faq.q: He pai ēnei kēmu mō te tangata whai mate Alzheimer?
faq.a: Āe. Ko te mate Alzheimer te tino take matua o te mate wareware, ā, i hangaia ngā kēmu mō tēnei kaupapa: he whakaahua nui e tūwhera tonu ana, he torutoru noa ngā kōwhiringa, ā, kāore he mea hei maumahara, hei hē rānei. Ko te whakataurite, te kōmaka, me te whakaoti i ngā kōrero matawhānui e whirinaki ana ki ngā mātauranga o mua, kaua ki te ako i ngā mea hou.

faq.q: Ka taea e te tangata kei te wāhanga tōmuri o te mate wareware te whakamahi i ēnei ngohe?
faq.a: I te nuinga o te wā, āe, mēnā he tangata kei tōna taha. Me tīmata ki te Rapua te mea ōrite me ngā whakaahua e rua, ngā Takirua whakaahua me ngā tāera e whā, he whārangi whakakikī tae, he wā whakatā mārie rānei hei whakangā manawa. Kia poto noa, whāia tā rātou e hiahia ai, ā, me mutu tonu ina kua ranea ki a rātou.

Kāore he pūkete, kāore hoki he pānuitanga kei tēnei paetukutuku. Ka whakamahi mātou i a Google Analytics kia mārama ai he aha ngā whārangi e tirohia ana. Ko ngā whakaahua ka kōwhiria e koe mō ngā Takirua whakaahua ka whakaaturia anake i roto i tō pūtirotiro, ā, e kore rawa e tukuna atu ki waho.

faq.q: Ko wai kei te hanga i a Golden Moments?
faq.a: He rōpū iti a Golden Moments e mahi ana i ngā ngohe whakaahua māhorahora, mārie hoki mā ngā whānau me ngā kaitiaki, i runga i te paetukutuku, hei taupānga kore utu hoki. Ehara mātou i te kaimahi rongoā, ā, kāore kau he tohutohu hauora i konei.

healthNotice.title: He mōhiohio whānui, ehara i te tohutohu rongoā
healthNotice.textHtml: E whakarāpopoto ana tēnei whārangi i ngā rangahau kua whakaputaina hei painga mō ngā whānau. E kore e taea te tohutohu he aha te mea tika mā tētahi tangata kotahi. Kōrero ki tētahi tākuta i mua i te whakarerekē i te kai, te korikori tinana, te moe, ngā rongoā, ngā tāpiringa kai rānei. Mō te pōhēhē whakarere, ētahi atu huringa ohorere rānei, me rapu tonu i te āwhina hauora. Pānuitia tā mātou pānui mōhiohio hauora.

about.title: He Mahi Ngātahi, Ehara i te Whakamātautau Mahara
about.seoTitle: Mō Golden Moments: Tā Mātou Whakaaro
about.description: Te take kāore he matawā, he māka, he whakawhiwhinga rānei i ngā kēmu a Golden Moments, te take e tūwhera tonu ai ngā whakaahua, me ngā mea ka kīia, e kore hoki e kīia e mātou mō te mate wareware.
about.lede: Ka hangaia e Golden Moments he ngohe whakaahua māhorahora mā ngā pakeke e taea ana e te kaitiaki me te tangata e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware te ngahau tahi ki tētahi taha, ki tētahi taha.
about.bodyHtml:
Ā mātou whakapono

Ko te tino kaupapa o te mahi, ko taua wā tonu: he kōrero tahi, he menemene, ko te hari i te tūhonotanga o ngā whakaahua e rua, he noho tahi noa rānei. Ehara i te mea hei whanganga i te tangata, hei akiaki rānei i a rātou kia anga whakamua tonu, hei whakaatu rānei i tētahi mahi nui.

He maha ngā taupānga whakapakari roro kua hoahoatia mō te tere, te piro, ngā rārangi wikitoria me ngā taumata. Ki te tangata e whai mate wareware ana, he rite tērā ki tētahi whakamātautau e kore e taea te eke. He rerekē katoa tā mātou i hoahoa ai, ā, ka whai mātou i ēnei tikanga:

  • Kāore he mea hei hinganga. Kāore he karaka, he piro, he tatau nekehanga, he manawa ora, he rārangi wikitoria, he kānati, he tatau whakamuri rānei, i runga i tētahi mata.
  • Ko te mōhiotanga i mua i te maumaharatanga. Ka noho kitea tonu ngā whakaahua. Ka akiaki ngā tohu i te kōrero, ā, kāore rawa e whakamātautau ingoa, maumaharatanga rānei.
  • He rahi, he māmā, he tūmau. He rahi ngā kupu me ngā whakaahua, he mārama te rerekē o ngā tae, ā, ka noho ngā pātene ki te wāhi kotahi tonu.
  • Te rangatiratanga o te pakeke. He whakaahua o te ao tūturu me ngā kupu māori, mahana hoki. Kāore he pakiwaituhi, he mihi waiata, he tohu emoji rānei.
  • He putanga māmā. Ka kitea tonu te pātene “Kua mutu mō tēnei wā”. He hua pai tonu te tū i te haurua o te mahi.
  • He tūmataiti māori noa. Kāore he pūkete, he pānuitanga rānei. Ka noho ngā whakaahua ka kōwhiria e koe ki tō pūrere tonu.

Ko ngā mea kāore e kīia ana e mātou

He mea hanga ā mātou kēmu mō te ngahau me te honotanga tahi. Kāore ēnei e whakatau mate, e whakamātau, e whanganga, e rongoā, e whakatepe, e ārai rānei i te mate wareware me te mate Alzheimer, ā, kaua rawa he tangata e kōwhiri i ēnei mō aua take. Ina tuhituhi mātou mō ngā rangahau i ā mātou whārangi hauora roro, ka kōrero mārama mātou ina ngoikore ana ngā taunakitanga, ā, kāore rawa mātou e hono i aua rangahau ki ā mātou ake kēmu.

Ko wai mātou

He rōpū motuhake iti a Golden Moments. Ehara mātou i te kaimahi hauora. I tuhia ā mātou ārahitanga mai i ngā aratohu kua whakaputaina e ngā rōpū pēnei i te National Institute on Aging me te Alzheimer’s Association, ā, kei ia aratohu te rārangi o ōna mātāpuna. Pānuihia te tikanga mō te tuhituhi me te tirotiro i ā mātou whārangi.

Kōrero mai he aha ngā mea hei āwhina

E hiahia ana mātou ki te rongo i ngā mea e whai hua ana ki a koe me ngā mea kāore i te pai, inarā mai i te hunga whai mate wareware, ngā kaitiaki whānau, me ngā kaimahi whakarite mahi. Tukua he īmēra ki {email}.

editorial.title: Te Tuhituhi me te Tirotiro i ā Mātou Whārangi
editorial.description: Te āhua o te rangahau, te tuhituhi, te whai mātāpuna, me te whakahou a Golden Moments i āna whārangi ngohe mate wareware me te hauora roro, me ngā mea e kore rawa e whakaputaina e mātou.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Ō mātou mātāpuna

I ahu mai ā mātou ārahitanga i ngā aratohu tūmatanui a ngā rōpū pēnei i te National Institute on Aging, te CDC, te Alzheimer’s Association, te Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, te Family Caregiver Alliance me te NHS, ā, i runga hoki i ngā rangahau arotake-ā-hoa pēnei i ngā arotakenga a Cochrane me ngā whakamātau haumanu nunui. Kei ia ārahitanga te rārangi mātāpuna e whāia ana e ia. Ka āta pānuitia ia mātāpuna i mua i te whakahuatanga, ā, ko tāna noa i kī tūturu ai tā mātou e whakaatu ana.

Tā mātou tikanga tuhituhi

  • Mātua whai take: ngā mea hei mahi i tēnei rā tonu, i roto i te reo māmā.
  • Pono ki ngā taunakitanga: ka kī mātou “e hono ana ki”, “tērā pea”, me te kī “he whakahē ngā taunakitanga” ina koirā te pono.
  • Whakaute: he pakeke te tirohanga ki te hunga whai mate wareware i roto i ā mātou tuhituhinga, ā, kāore rawa he reo uiui, he reo whakamā rānei.
  • Kāore he kōrero pokanoa: kāore he tatauranga, he whakahua kupu, he mātanga, he rangahau, he arotake, he whakaaturanga rānei kua hangaia noatia.

Ko wai e arotake ana i ā mātou whārangi

He mea tuhituhi, he mea tirotiro ngā whārangi e te rōpū o Golden Moments, me te āwhina a ngā taputapu tuhituhi AI mō te rangahau me te whakatakoto tauira. Ka tirohia ia whārangi ki ōna ake mātāpuna e te rōpū. Kāore ā mātou whārangi i arotakengia e tētahi rata, e tētahi kaimahi hauora rānei, ā, kāore rawa mātou e kī he pērā. He whakamārama whānui noa iho ēnei, ehara i te tohutohu rongoā.

Ngā mea e kore rawa e whakaputaina e mātou

  • Kōrero e kī ana mā tētahi kēmu, kai, tāpiringa kai, nohopuku, tikanga rānei e ārai, e rongoā, e whakatepe, e whakaora rānei te mate wareware.
  • Whakamātautau, pātai, piro rānei e kī ana he mate wareware tō tētahi, kāore rānei ōna mate wareware.
  • Tohutohu ki te tīmata, ki te whakamutu, ki te whakarerekē rānei i tētahi rongoā.
  • Pānuitanga hokohoko, ihirangi tautoko rānei kua hunaia hei aratohu.

Ngā whakahoutanga me ngā whakatikanga

Kei ia whārangi te rā i whakahoutia whakamutunga ai. Mehemea ka kitea e koe he hē, he mātāpuna tawhito rānei, tukua he īmēra ki {email}, ā, ka tere tirohia e mātou.

faq.title: Ngā Pātai me ngā Whakautu
faq.seoTitle: Kēmu me ngā Ngohe Mate Wareware: Ngā Pātai me ngā Whakautu
faq.description: Ngā whakautu ki ngā pātai noa mō ngā kēmu me ngā ngohe mate wareware: ko tēhea kēmu hei whakamātau, kia pēhea te roa o te tākaro, ngā whakaaro mō ngā wāhanga o muri mai, te hauora roro me te tūmataititanga.
faq.lede: He whakautu poto, māmā ki ngā pātai e tino pātaia ana e ngā kaitiaki.

items.q: He aha ngā kēmu tino pai mō te tangata e whai mate wareware ana?
items.a: Ko ngā kēmu tino pai he mea mātatau, he māmā, kāore hoki he pēhanga, ā, ko te kēmu tika ko tērā e pai ana ki te tangata i tēnei rā tonu. He pai ki te tokomaha te whakarōpū whakaahua e kitea ana, te kōmaka, ngā panga māmā, te whakaoti kīwaha mātatau, te tā whakaahua, me te pingo whakaahua. Kaua e whakamahi i ngā matawā, ngā piro, me ngā mea katoa e rite ana ki te whakamātautau.

items.q: He kore utu tūturu ēnei kēmu?
items.a: Āe. He koreutu ngā kēmu katoa me ngā rauemi tā, kāore he pūkete, he rēhita, he tikiake, he pānuitanga rānei.

items.q: He aha i kore ai he kaute, he taumata, he taima rānei?
items.a: Mā te tere me ngā kaute ka rite tētahi mahi ngahau ki tētahi whakamātautau, ā, ka puta pea he whakamā, he pōrearea rānei. Ko te aronga matua ko te ngahau me te wā noho tahi, nō reira kāore he mea e hinga ai koe, ā, ka taea e koe te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa.

items.q: Ko ēhea pūrere ngā mea tino pai ki te whakamahi?
items.a: Ahakoa he waea kōrero, he papa rorohiko, he rorohiko rānei e whai pūtirotiro ipurangi hou ana. He pai tonu te papa rorohiko ki runga tūnga i te tēpu mō te hunga tokorua e noho tahi ana ki te taha o tētahi ki tētahi. Mō ngā rōpū, he pai te hono i te pona rorohiko ki te pouaka whakaata.

items.q: Ka taea e mātou te tākaro mā te whakamahi i ā mātou ake whakaahua whānau?
items.a: Āe. Ka hurihia e Photo pairs ngā whakaahua e 2 ki te 6 ka tīpakohia e koe hei kēmu takirua. Ka noho tonu ngā whakaahua ki tō pūtirotiro, ā, kāore e tukuna ake, e tiakina rānei ki tētahi atu wāhi.

groups.title: Ngā mahi me te manaaki tangata

items.q: Kia pēhea te roa o tētahi mahi?
items.a: He maha ngā wā he nui tonu te 10 ki te 20 meneti, ā, i ētahi wā he tino pai ahakoa he 2 meneti noa iho. Titiro mēnā e ngenge ana, e pōrearea ana rānei rātou, ā, me whakamutu i te wā e pai tonu ana te noho. Kāore he roa tōtika.

items.q: Ka ahatia mēnā kāore rātou e hiahia ki te whai wāhi ki tētahi mahi?
items.a: Whakautehia tō rātou whakakāhoretanga, ā, whakamātau anō ā muri ake, mā tētahi atu huarahi rānei. Ka hua pea te whakakāhore i te ngenge, te mamae, te koretake o te mōhio, te kore hiahia rānei. Tirohia tā mātou aratohu mō te mahi ina kore rātou e hiahia.

items.q: He aha ngā mahi e tika ana mō te wāhanga matatau o te mate wareware?
items.a: Ko te whakamarie me ngā rongo: ko te whakarongo ki ngā waiata e tino manakohia ana, ko te mirimiri ringa ki te kirīmi, ko te tirotiro whakaahua ngātahi, ko te pupuri i tētahi paraikete ngohengohe, ko te noho ki waho, ko tētahi kēmu whakaahua māmā noa iho rānei me tētahi tangata e noho tahi ana i tōna taha. He maha atu ngā whakaaro kei roto i tā mātou aratohu mō ngā wāhanga matatau.

items.q: He mahi anō mō ngā rōpū kei roto i ngā kāinga manaaki?
items.a: Āe. Kei a Picture bingo ngā kāri hei tā me te kaikēmu ki te mata rorohiko, ā, he pai hoki te pānui ā-waha i ngā kēmu Finish the saying me ngā Conversation cards. Kei roto i tā mātou aratohu mō ngā rōpū kāinga manaaki ngā kōrero mō te rahi o te rōpū, te whakariterite nohoanga, me te whakahāngai mō ngā taumata āhei rerekē.

items.q: Ka taea rānei e ngā kēmu te ārai, te whakatōtā rānei i te mate wareware?
items.a: Kāore anō kia kitea he kēmu hei ārai i te mate wareware, ā, kāore hoki ā mātou kēmu e kī pērā ana. Kua kitea e ngā rangahau ētahi painga iti o te whakaohooho whakaaro i roto i ngā horopaki whakawhanaunga mō te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware māmā, tōtika noa iho rānei, engari he rerekē tērā i te kēmu hei ārai i te mate. Ka whakaratohia e mātou ēnei kēmu hei oranga ngākau, hei whakawhanaungatanga hoki.

items.q: Ka taea rānei te ārai i te mate wareware?
items.a: Kāore e tino taea te kī taurangi. Kua kitea e ngā rangahau he hononga kei waenga i ētahi āhuatanga hauora, momo noho hoki e 14 me te mōrea o te mate wareware, pērā i te turi, te pēhanga toto tiketike, te kore korikori tinana, me te noho mokemoke. Tērā pea ka whakaiti te whakatika i ēnei i te mōrea mō ētahi tāngata, engari he tokomaha tonu te hunga e whai ana i ngā huarahi tika katoa ka pāngia tonu e te mate wareware. Ehara rawa i te he nō tētahi.

items.q: He pai rānei te nohopuku wā poto mō te hauora o te roro?
items.a: He iti noa iho, he tōmua hoki ngā taunakitanga i roto i te tangata, ā, kei roto kē i ngā kararehe te nuinga o ngā rangahau. Ka noho mōrea pea te nohopuku mō ngā kaumātua, inā koa te hunga e tango rongoā ana mō te mate huka, te hunga rānei kua heke ohorere te taumaha, ā, kāore e tūtohua ana mō ngā tāngata e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware. Kōrero ki tētahi tākuta i mua i te panoni i tō kai.

items.q: E kohikohi ana koutou i ētahi pārongo?
items.a: Kāore he pūkete, kāore he pānuitanga. Ka whakamahi mātou i a Google Analytics hei tatau i ngā toronga me te kite ko ēhea whārangi e āwhina ana, ā, ka maumahara tō pūtirotiro mēnā i whakakāhia e koe ngā oro ngāwari. Kāore rawa ngā whakaahua ka kōwhiria e koe mō Photo pairs e tukuna ake. Tirohia te pānui tūmataitinga mō ngā taipitopito.
Kāo. He kaupapa whakangahau, he mōhiohio whānui noa iho a Golden Moments. Mō ngā pātai hauora, kōrero ki tētahi tākuta, ā, mō ngā ohorere waea atu ki te 111.

faq.moreHtml: He taipitopito anō: te tākaro ngātahi, ina whakakāhore rātou, ngā mahi mō te wāhanga matatau me ka taea rānei te ārai i te mate wareware?

handout.title: He Kēmu Koreutu, Ngāwari Hoki mā te Hunga e Noho Tahi ana me te Mate Wareware
handout.seoTitle: Pepa Tā hei Tohatoha: He Kēmu Mate Wareware Koreutu i te Ipurangi
handout.description: He pepa tā whārangi-tahi hei tohatoha mā ngā whānau me ngā kaitiaki mō ngā kēmu whakaahua koreutu, ngāwari hoki mā te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware, mō ngā rōpū tautoko me ngā pōkai manaaki.
handout.lede: Tāngia tēnei whārangi mō tētahi rōpū tautoko, pōkai manaaki, mō te tatau kāpata mātao rānei. Whakamahia te whakahau Tā o tō pūtirotiro; ka mahue atu ngā tahua me ngā pātene i te pepa tā.
handout.introHtml: He whakaahua nui, he kupu māmā, ā, kāore he mea hei hinganga māu. He koreutu i runga waea kōrero, papa rorohiko, rorohiko rānei, kāore he rēhita, kāore he pānuitanga, kāore he taima, kāore hoki he kaute. E noho tahataha, ka whakawhitiwhiti ai i ngā hurihanga.
handout.restHtml:
Ētahi tohutohu āwhina

  • Kōwhiria he wā o te rā e tino pai ana te noho a te tangata.
  • Tīmata ki te taumata māmā katoa. He nui tonu ngā tāpa e whā.
  • Kōrerorero mō ngā whakaahua. Ko te whakawhiti kōrero tonu te wāhanga pai rawa o te mahi.
  • Whakamutua i te wā e pai tonu ana te noho. He hua pai tonu te whakamutu wawe.

Ētahi atu mea kei te pae tukutuku

  • Ngā rauemi tā koreutu: he rapu kupu momotuhi nui, he whārangi whakakākahu tae, he kāri kōrerorero, he kēmu picture bingo hoki.
  • He whakaaro mahi mō ia wāhanga, me ngā aratohu mō te tākaro ngātahi me te manaaki i a koe anō.

Mō te ngahau me te noho tahi. Ehara i te tohutohu hauora, i te whakamātautau, i te maimoatanga rānei. Kua whakaputaina a Golden Moments e Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.title: Mō ngā Kāinga Manaaki, ngā Whare Pukapuka me ngā Rōpū Tautoko
organizations.seoTitle: Ngā Ngohe Mate Wareware Koreutu mā ngā Whare Tiaki me ngā Rōpū
organizations.description: Me pēhea ngā whare tiaki, ngā hōtaka awatea mō te hunga pakeke, ngā whare pukapuka, ngā ratonga kaumātua, me ngā rōpū tautoko e whakamahi ai i ā mātou kēmu mate wareware koreutu, me ngā kupu hei tāpiri i a mātou ki tētahi rārangi rauemi.
organizations.lede: He koreutu ngā mea katoa i tēnei pae tukutuku hei whakamahi mā ngā kainoho, ngā mema, me ngā kiritaki; kāore he kaute, he raihana, he utu rānei. E whakamārama ana tēnei whārangi i ngā mea kei konei me ngā huarahi hei tohatoha atu.
organizations.shortText: {name}: he kēmu whakaahua marino, koreutu, me ngā aratohu ngohe mā te hunga e noho nei me te mate wareware me ō rātou kaitiaki. Kāore he rēhita, kāore he taima, kāore he piro.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) offers {count} free browser games made for people living with dementia, including matching pairs with pictures left showing, an easy jigsaw, sorting, familiar sayings and picture bingo with printable cards. There is no account, advertising, timer or score. The site also has plain-language activity guides for each stage of dementia that cite the National Institute on Aging and the Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.useTitle: Ngā mea ka taea e ngā whakahaere te whakamahi
organizations.gamesItemHtml: He kēmu pūtirotiro e {count} e mahi ana i runga pona, papa rorohiko, i tētahi pouaka whakaata rānei e tūhono ana ki te rorohiko. Kāore he whakauru pūmanawa, he kaute, he tikiake rānei. Tirohia ngā kēmu katoa.
organizations.printablesAfter: Whakamahia te pātene Tā kei ia whārangi.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Mā ngā rōpū: Kei te Pīngo whakaahua he kāri hei tā me tētahi kaiwhakahau kei te mata, ā, kei ngā pātaitai māmā ētahi pātai e 50 me ngā kōwhiringa whakautu me ngā kaupapa kōrero.
  • He aratohu ngohe mā ngā kaimahi me ngā whānau, e ai ki te wāhanga me te momo, i tuhia ki te reo mārama me ngā puna kōrero. Tīmata ki ngā ariā ngohe e 101, ki ngā ngohe rōpū mō ngā whare tiaki rānei.
organizations.restHtml:
Te whakamahi a ngā rōpū

  • Ngā whare tiaki me ngā ratonga mahara: he pīngo whakaahua, he whakaoti kīwaha rānei i te pouaka whakaata o te rūma noho tahi, mā tētahi tangata kotahi e pāpā te mata mō te rōpū.
  • Ngā hōtaka awatea mō te hunga pakeke: he wāhi papa rorohiko kei reira ngā Takirua whakaahua e whakatakotoria ana ki ngā tāpa e whā, mō ētahi wātaka poto takitahi.
  • Ngā whare pukapuka tūmatanui: he rapu kupu kua tāia me ngā kāri kōrerorero i roto i ngā kete mahara, ā, kua tohua hoki te pae tukutuku ki ngā papa rorohiko o te whare pukapuka.
  • Ngā rōpū tautoko kaitiaki me ngā kāwhe mahara: he puka toha whārangi-kotahi hei tā mā ngā whānau hei mau ki te kāinga.
  • Ngā hōhipera me ngā kaiwhakarite putanga: te puka toha i roto i ngā pōkai mā ngā kaitiaki, hei mahi marino ki te kāinga, ki te taha moenga rānei.

Ko ngā mea kāore e mahia e mātou

He mea hanga ngā kēmu mō te ngahau me te noho tahi noa iho. Kāore he mahi whakatau mate, he whakamātautau, he tapeke piro, he rongoā, he whakaroa rānei i te mate wareware, ā, e tono ana mātou kia kaua ngā whakahaere e whakaatu pērā i a rātou. Kāore kau he pānuitanga hokohoko, ā, kāore hoki ngā kēmu e tono ingoa, taipitopito hauora, whakaahua rānei kia tukuna ake. E whakamahi ana te pae tukutuku i a Google Analytics hei tatau i ngā toronga mai; e whakamārama ana tā mātou pānui tūmataiti i ngā mea e kohia ana. Ko ngā whakaahua ka whakamahia i roto i te Takirua whakaahua ka noho tonu ki te pūtirotiro.

Tāpirihia mai mātou ki tāu rārangi rauemi

Mēnā he rārangi rauemi tāu mā ngā kaitiaki, he pai noa iho te hono mai ki {domain}. Ka taea e koe te tārua i tētahi o ngā whakamārama.
organizations.linksHtml:
He whārangi whaihua hei hono tōtika atu: kēmu koreutu, rauemi tā koreutu, ngā ngohe mō te Alzheimer's me te tākaro tahi.

He pātai, he whakatikanga rānei

Mēnā he hapa, he mea rangirua rānei kei te pae, kāore rānei e tutuki ngā hiahia o tētahi kainoho i ngā mea kei konei, me whakamōhio mai ki a mātou i {email}. Tēnā koa kaua e tuku mai he kōrero whaiaro, he kōrero hauora rānei e pā ana ki ngā kainoho me ngā kiritaki.

app.title: Te Taupānga Golden Moments
app.seoTitle: Te Taupānga Golden Moments mō te iPhone me te Android
app.description: Te taupānga koreutu o Golden Moments: he whakarōpū whakaahua marino me ngā tāpa nunui e whā, ka noho tonu ngā whakaahua whānau ki tō pūrere, he pōkai whakaahua tuimotu, ā, kāore he kaute.
app.lede: Ngā mea katoa e paingia ana e koe i te pae tukutuku, i roto i tētahi taupānga e mahi ana i te wā tuimotu, ā, ka taea te whakamahi i ngā whakaahua whānau e kōwhiria ana e koe.
app.bodyHtml:
Tīmata paku noa

Tīmata ki ngā tāra nunui e whā me ngā whakaahua taunga. Waiho ngā whakaahua kia kitea tonutia, huna rānei ina wātea taua whakaaro. Kāore he matawā, he māka, he whiunga rānei i roto i te aratau ngāwari. Kōwhiria kia 4, 6, 8, 12 rānei ngā tāra.

Whakawhaiarotia

Kōwhiria ētahi whakaahua ā-whānau mā te kōwhiringa whakaahua a tō pūrere. Ka tiakina e te taupānga ētahi kape iti iho mō āna mahi. Kāore e tirotirohia tō kohinga whakaahua, kāore hoki e hurihia ō whakaahua tūturu, ā, ka taea te pupuri kia tae ki te 24 ngā whakaahua ki tētahi kohinga kotahi.

Mātakitaki tahi noa

Tirohia kia kotahi noa te whakaahua i ia wā. Mā ētahi kōrero akiaki (tē herea) e whakatenatena te whakawhiti kōrero, me te kore tono i tētahi kia maumahara ki ngā ingoa, kia tuku whakautu tika rānei. He nui noa iho te mātakitaki noa iho.

Whakamahia tuimotu i ngā wā whakahirahira

Kua whakaurua ngā whakaahua tīmata me ngā mōkī whakaahua e waru katoa ki roto i te taupānga. E mahi tonu ana ngā kape whakaahua i tikiakehia ahakoa tuimotu. Mēnā kei te iCloud anake ngā whakaahua tūturu e tiakina ana, tērā pea ka hiahiatia he hononga ipurangi ina kōwhiria.

Kāore he pūkete, kāore he tūmau tukutahi whakaahua

Ka noho tonu ngā kape whakaahua ā-whānau ki roto i te taupānga i runga i te pūrere. Ka taea te muku i ngā kape me te kore e mukua ngā whakaahua tūturu. Tērā pea ka uru ngā raraunga taupānga ki roto i ngā pūrua pūrere. Pānuitia te kaupapahere tūmataiti o te taupānga, ā, mā te āwhina mō te taupānga koe e ārahi i ia hipanga.
app.disclaimer: Kua hoahoatia a Golden Moments mō te whakangahau me te kōrerorero ngātahi. Kāore e tohu mate, kāore e rongoā, kāore e ārai, kāore hoki e whanganga i te mate wareware, i te mate Alzheimer rānei.

faq.q: Ko tēhea kēmu hei tīmatanga mā mātou?
faq.a: He tīmatanga marino te kēmu Takirua Whakaahua me ngā tāra e whā. Mēnā he taumaha te kōwhiri i waenga i ngā whakaahua, whakamāatauria te kēmu Rapua te Mea Ōrite me ngā whakaahua e rua. Mō tētahi rōpū, whakamāatauria te Pingo Whakaahua.

faq.q: E mahi ana anō ēnei kēmu i runga iPad, waea pūkoro rānei?
faq.a: Āe. Ka mahi ia kēmu i roto i te pūtirotiro i runga waea, papa rorohiko, rorohiko hoki, ā, ka whakanuia ngā whakaahua kia kapi ai te mata. I te nuinga o te wā, ko te papa rorohiko i runga tūnga te mea tino hāneanea mō ngā tāngata tokorua.

faq.q: He pai anō ēnei kēmu mō tētahi e whai mate Alzheimer ana?
faq.a: Āe. I hangaia mō te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware, tae atu ki te mate Alzheimer, koia te pūtake e kitea rawatia ana. Ka noho kitea tonutia ngā whakaahua, he torutoru noa ngā kōwhiringa, ā, kāore he matawā, he māka rānei, nā reira ka whirinaki kē ngā kēmu ki te mōhio ki ngā mea taunga, kaua ki te mahara ki ngā mea hōu.

faq.q: He kēmu mahara ēnei mō te hunga kaumātua?
faq.a: He kēmu taurite, he kēmu whakaahua hoki ka taea e te hunga kaumātua katoa te ngahau atu, engari i hangaia kia kaua e whakamātau i te mahara: i roto i te Takirua Whakaahua, ka anga-runga tonu ngā whakaahua hāunga anō mēnā ka kōwhiria kia hunaia. Kei tā mātou aratohu mō ngā kēmu mahara mā te hunga kaumātua whai mate wareware ngā whakamārama mō te pupuri i ngā kēmu mahara katoa kia ngāwari tonu.

faq.q: He kēmu anō mō ngā rōpū i roto i te kāinga atawhai?
faq.a: Āe. Kei te Pingo Whakaahua ētahi kāri hei tā me tētahi kaiwhakataki i runga mata, ā, he pai te pānui ā-waha ki tētahi rōpū mō ngā kēmu Whakaotia te Kīwaha me ngā Kāri Whakawhiti Kōrero.

appFacts.summary: He taupānga utukore mō te iPhone, iPad me te Android me te taurite whakaahua ngāwari ki ngā tāra nunui e whā ki te tekau mā rua, te taurite me te mātakitaki tahi i ngā whakaahua ā-whānau e kōwhiria e koe, me ngā mōkī whakaahua e waru kei roto e mahi ana ahakoa kāore he ipurangi. Kāore he pūkete, he pānuitanga, he matawā, he māka rānei.
features: He taurite whakaahua ngāwari ki ngā tāra nunui e 4, e 6, e 8, e 12 rānei; ka kitea tonutia ngā whakaahua hāunga anō mēnā ka whiriwhiria kia hunaia
Ka tāia he kape o ngā whakaahua ā-whānau e kōwhiria e koe ki roto i te taupānga mō te taurite me te mātakitaki tahi
Mātakitaki tahi: he whakaahua kotahi i ia wā me ētahi kōrero akiaki (tē herea) mō te whakawhiti kōrero
E waru ngā mōkī whakaahua kei roto i te taupānga; e mahi tuimotu ana
Kāore he pūkete, he pānuitanga, he hoko i roto i te taupānga, he matawā, he māka, he whiunga rānei

faq.q: He taupānga ngohe anō mō te mate wareware?
faq.a: Āe. He utukore a Golden Moments (kua rārangitia hei "{storeName}") i runga i te App Store me te Google Play. He whakaatu i te taurite whakaahua ngāwari ki ngā tāra nunui, he kēmu me ngā whakaahua ā-whānau e kōwhiria e koe, me ētahi mōkī whakaahua e mahi tuimotu ana.

faq.q: He utukore anō te taupānga Golden Moments?
faq.a: Āe. He utukore te tikiake, kāore he pānuitanga, he pūkete, he hoko rānei i roto i te taupānga.

faq.q: E mahi tonu ana te taupānga me te kore ipurangi?
faq.a: Āe. Kua whakaurua ngā whakaahua tīmata me ngā mōkī whakaahua e waru katoa ki roto i te taupānga, ā, ka mahi tuimotu ngā whakaahua ā-whānau ina oti te kape ki roto i te taupānga. Mēnā kei te iCloud anake tētahi whakaahua e tiakina ana, tērā pea ka hiahiatia he hononga ina kōwhiria.

faq.q: Ka taea anō e mātou ā mātou ake whakaahua ā-whānau te whakamahi?
faq.a: Āe. Kōwhiria he whakaahua mā te kōwhiri whakaahua o tō pūrere. Ka pupuri te taupānga i ētahi tārua iti iho i runga i te pūrere mō āna ngohe, kāore e tukuake ki te ipurangi, ā, e kore rawa e panoni i ngā whakaahua taketake. Ka taea e koe te tango i aua tārua i ngā wā katoa.

faq.q: He taupānga whakapakari roro, he whakamātau mahara rānei tēnei?
faq.a: Kāo. He mea hanga a Golden Moments hei whakangahau, hei noho tahi hoki. Kāore ōna kaute, kāore hoki he whakamātau, ā, kāore e whakatau mate, e rongoā, e ārai, e whanganga rānei i te mate wareware, i te mate Alzheimer rānei.

faq.q: Ka mahi tēnei ki runga i ēhea pūrere?

gameFaqYes.q: He taupānga anō tō tēnei kēmu?
gameFaqYes.a: Āe. Kei te taupānga koreutu o Golden Moments mō te iPhone, iPad me te Android taua momo whōrite whakaahua māmā nei, ka taea te whakamahi i ngā whakaahua whānau e kōwhiria ana e koe, ā, ka mahi ahakoa kāore he hononga ipurangi. Kāore he pūkete, he pānuitanga, he kaute rānei.

gameFaqNo.q: He taupānga anō tō tēnei kēmu?
gameFaqNo.a: Kāore mō tēnei kēmu. Kei te taupānga koreutu o Golden Moments mō te iPhone, iPad me te Android he whōrite whakaahua māmā me ngā tāera rahi me ngā whakaahua whānau e kōwhiria ana e koe, ā, ka mahi ahakoa kāore he hononga ipurangi. E noho koreutu tonu ana tēnei kēmu i konei i tō pūtirotiro.
